sources.excerpt: Box of Rock - Vertical by ZVEX Effects | The Guitar Pedal Directory Effect Pedals Manufacturers Effect Types Guitar Effect Pedal by ZVEX Effects Box of Rock - Vertical The ZVex Box of Rock Vertical is a compact overdrive pedal that replicates the sound of a classic amp stack. The ZVex Box of Rock Vertical is a compact overdrive pedal that replicates the sound of a classic amp stack, offering rich distortion and a "rock" tone with a signature touch of ZVex's unique voice. It features two main modes: a distortion circuit and a boost, delivering a wide range of tones from smooth overdrive to high-gain rock sounds. Its vertical design saves space while maintaining the pedal's powerful performance.
